response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus

assumptions.assumption: "High bandwidth usage" means bandusagepct strictly greater than 47.6 (the cutoff itself is excluded).
Telescopes with NULL bandusagepct are excluded, and telescopes with NULL calibrstatus appear as their own group.

alternatives.interpretation: High bandwidth usage includes the cutoff, so bandusagepct >= 47.6.
